name: Marine Conservation Initiative
summary: Annual grants to established US non-profits for marine habitat recovery and protection on the Island of Hawaii, prioritising West Hawaii coastal, nearshore and ridge-to-reef watershed projects.

eligibility.rule: Be a public charity with tax-exempt 501(c)(3) status for at least 3 years
Keep a grant request within 30% of the organization's annual budget
For a multi-year request, be a current grantee or have an invitation
Not for general operating costs, endowment, re-granting or activities promoting religion

documents: Proof of IRS federal tax-exempt status, 501(c)3
Project budget with other current and prospective funders

status.quote: Submit your letter of inquiry by clicking the "SUBMIT LETTER OF INQUIRY" button at the end of the online form on or before May 30, 2026, 5:00 pm HST.

deadline.quote: Submit your letter of inquiry by clicking the "SUBMIT LETTER OF INQUIRY" button at the end of the online form on or before May 30, 2026, 5:00 pm HST.

applicant_types.quote: Must be a public charity and have had tax-exempt 501(c)3 status for a minimum of 3 years.

geography.quote: Priority is given to West Hawaiʻi coastal, nearshore, and related watershed (ridge-to-reef) projects, North Kohala to Miloliʻi.

access.quote: Submission of a letter of inquiry will only be accepted online.

effort.quote: Submit your letter of inquiry by clicking the "SUBMIT LETTER OF INQUIRY" button at the end of the online form on or before May 30, 2026, 5:00 pm HST.

eligibility.quote: Must be a public charity and have had tax-exempt 501(c)3 status for a minimum of 3 years.
Government agencies are not eligible to apply directly.
Grant request does not exceed 30% of the organization's annual budget.
Multi-year funding requests (up to three years) are accepted from current grantees only or by invitation only.

General operating expenses (overhead and other administrative costs are acceptable for the program and project for which funding is being requested). Endowment. Re-granting to other organizations without prior approval and a signed grant agreement. Re-granting to other individuals. Activities that promote religious beliefs.
Must be based in the USA.

documents.quote: Proof of IRS federal tax-exempt status, 501(c)3. Operating budget (organizations with multiple branches or chapters must submit a state-specific budget).
Project budget that includes a list of other current and prospective funders to the proposed project/program.
